summary: Iteration 115 verified all 10 review-request items for the Tamamliyo insurance integration + UI polish (express copy, D-U-B-A-I phone letters, wider /vize-tipleri, moved TripSuggestions to step 4, cart insured identity, admin insurance provider panel). Frontend Playwright: (a) /vize-tipleri renders exactly ONE addon card [data-testid=addon-card-express] with '12 saat içinde sonuç', price 2.470 ₺ /kişi başı and '≈ 50 $ · güncel kurla TL tahsil', button [addon-apply-express] navigates to /basvuru; NO card with data-testid=addon-card-instant_express and text 'Anında Ekspres', 'mesai saat', '8 mesai' are absent. (b) Content widths at 1920 viewport measured: navbar logo left=280, .panel-float left=280 right=1640 width=1360, [data-testid=pricing-grid] left=280 right=1640 width=1360 — exactly matching spec (wide navbar-aligned). (c) Navbar+footer phone links show href=tel:+905337438224 with [data-testid=phone-dubai] rendering '+90 533 74' then digits 3-8-2-2-4 each stacked with letters D,U,B,A,I under. (d) /basvuru step 1 does NOT contain [data-testid=trip-suggestions]. (e) /sepet standalone insurance flow: added ins_15d to cart, cart-insured-block appears with cart-insured-name-0/tckn-0/birth-0; submitting empty triggers Turkish toast '1. sigortalı için ad soyad, geçerli TC kimlik no ve doğum tarihi girin.'; with valid data (TEST Sigortali, TCKN 10000000146, birth 1990-01-15) + travel_start + Havale/EFT the order was created and navigated to /siparis/SV-OAR0AKNQ (order later cleaned up). (f) /admin/sigorta ProviderPanel shows state='Bağlı', last sync='07.09.2026 16:37', auto-issue Switch aria-checked=false (OFF by default), clicking [insurance-sync-prices] shows toast '4 poliçe fiyatı güncellendi.' (issue-provider buttons intentionally NOT clicked). Backend regression via direct HTTP: POST /api/orders with insurance line + missing insured => 400 'Poliçe kesilebilmesi için 1 sigortalının ad-soyad, TC kimlik no ve doğum tarihi bilgisi gerekiyor.'; invalid TCKN 11111111111 => 422 pydantic 'Geçerli bir TC kimlik numarası girin.'; with valid insured + travel_start => 200. GET /api/products?kind=insurance returns exactly 4 (ins_7d 490, ins_15d 560, ins_30d 590, ins_60d 740), each price_try == round(cost_try*2/10)*10. GET /api/content/site returns exactly 1 addon 'express' with features containing '12 saat içinde sonuç'. Pytest suite: 308 passed, 3 skipped, 2 pre-existing failures caused by /api/contact rate-limit (429) due to earlier tests in this session — not related to this iteration.

minor.issue: test_contact_creates_outbox_entry and test_contact_email_escapes_user_input fail with 429 in full suite runs when other contact tests already exhausted the per-IP rate limit; pass in isolated re-runs after cooldown. Consider raising the limit for test env or adding fixture cooldown.

critical_code_review_comments: PhoneDubai renders spacing digits (positions between 743|8|2|24) as ' ' which is fine visually but concatenated textContent produces '+90 533 743D  8U2B  2A4I' — read-aloud/screen-reader users may hear that mangled sequence; consider aria-label='+90 533 743 82 24' on the phone anchor to keep accessibility clean.

Apply wizard Step 4 end-to-end (with real photo AI check) was not exercised in this pass because the AI face check is a pre-existing gating limitation flagged in the request; the underlying insurance-identity validation was covered via the equivalent Cart flow and direct API tests.

success_rate.backend: 100% for iteration scope (order/insurance/content/products); 99.4% overall (308/310 pytest, 2 pre-existing 429 flakes)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 10 UI checks in the request met)
